title: Surjectivity on first Tor after a flat intermediate base change
statement: Let $R\to A\to B$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings and $M$ an $R$-module. Assume $M\otimes_RA$ is a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then the natural $B$-linear map $\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(M,A)\otimes_AB\to\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(M,B)$ [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], induced by $A\to B$ in the second variable, is surjective.
